observation.description: replaceBearerToken (the documented external-bearer authority transition) to a lesser-privileged principal: (1) rejects with AggregateError 'external bearer custody transition completed with lifecycle failures' whose inner error is the EXPECTED SNAPBACK_AUTH_PERMISSION_DENIED - the app must string-match to learn the transition actually completed; (2) blanks predecessor rows (correct) but the successor's denial never surfaces on the query/hook - on-device the records query presents 'refreshing'/'ready' with zero rows and no error fact while the provider connection drops to 'disconnected'; and (3) rotating BACK to the original authority resolves clean but NEVER re-subscribes the attached handles: on the Expo/React-provider path the whole connection stays 'disconnected' with all queries (public included) blank until process restart; on the node control the protected handle stays disconnected/0 and the public handle presents connection 'live' WITH ZERO ROWS - blanked data labeled live. The documented contract ('retires old grants and transports, and only then fresh-subscribes under the successor') does not hold on either carrier.

competitorOutcome.description: Firebase RN: signing out and signing in as a different user swaps snapshot listeners to the new authority without wedging the transport; re-authenticating as the original user restores data.

mustNotRegress: The retirement half: predecessor rows blank BEFORE the successor subscribes, and denials stay uniform and non-disclosing.
smallestCoherentFix: Make the transition settle without throwing when it completes (successor denials become handle/hook lifecycle facts, e.g. a denial code on the query state), and make successor fresh-subscribe actually re-establish transports for surviving handles - with a conformance test that rotates a-b-a over live protected + public queries on both node and an RN-shaped carrier.
acceptanceWitness: Rotate alice-mallory-alice over a live provider: the transition resolves, the denial is renderable from the hook while mallory holds the bearer, and alice's rows re-render live afterwards with no process restart.
